text: 综合外媒报道，当地时间8月28日，中国芯片制造商长鑫存储(CXMT)向美国国防部提起诉讼，要求将其从一份黑名单中移除。 据彭博社，长鑫存储表示，其设计的芯片用于民用和商业用途，而非军事用途，并称其被错误地列入了黑名单。该诉讼已提交至美国哥伦比亚特区联邦地区法院，美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯也被列为被告。 在提交诉讼后发表的声明中，长鑫存储表示，公司并非军工企业，自2025年1月首次被列入黑名单以来，公司声誉和商业利益持续受损。该公司补充称，采取这一行动是为了保护商业利益。 据路透社，美国国防部在一份声明中称，“根据政策，国防部不对未判决或正在进行的诉讼发表
text_en: According to comprehensive foreign media reports, on August 28 local time, Chinese chipmaker ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) filed a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Defense demanding removal from a blacklist. Per Bloomberg, CXMT said its chips are designed for civilian and commercial use, not military, and claimed it was wrongly blacklisted. The suit was filed with the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia, with Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth also named as a defendant. In a statement after filing, CXMT said it is not a military enterprise and that its reputation and business interests have been continuously damaged since its initial blacklisting in January 2025, adding that the action was taken to protect commercial interests. Per Reuters, the Defense Department said in a statement that 'as a matter of policy, the department does not comment on pending or ongoing litigation.'
